content: A Group Detail GraphQL query should expose a single group(id: ID!) field whose Group type includes nested sessions, memberships, and a merged collection spotlight. The resolver delegates to existing services: Sessions::ForGroup, Memberships::ForGroup, and Collections::Merge scoped to the group's members. Use Dataloader to batch user/avatar lookups for the members panel. The invite token can be exposed via a nullable inviteCode field that only owners/admins can resolve (permission check in the field resolver). To avoid over-fetching, the shared collection spotlight should be a separate field (group.collectionSpotlight(limit: Int)) with its own resolver so the full collection is not loaded unless the view requests it.
